verdict.rationale: The evidence only says the Marketing Emails API can query 'post-send statistics' for an email. It never names bounce, complaint, or blocklist signals, and nothing describes guidance when deliverability degrades. Excluding unengaged contacts by default is a related send-time control, not deliverability monitoring, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see bounce, complaint, and blocklist signals per send and get actionable guidance when deliverability degrades
